The high-sensitivity PubMed query is saved as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/pubmed-search-builder-next-codex-noseed-20260927T004221Z/final_strategy.txt), with the publication cutoff set to **2017-05-06**.

The search retrieved **83,203 records** by that cutoff. It retrieved all 8 screened records from a matching prior review, but one record’s MeSH heading informed a revision, so that benchmark is now development-informed—not independent validation. The strategy still needs review by an information specialist before use.

The workflow and rationale are documented in [audit.md](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-535fe3dc7ca88971/pubmed-search-builder-next-codex-noseed-20260927T004221Z/work/audit.md). The internal critique found no open must-fix items; it was same-context and does not replace PRESS peer review.
